Document Title: Drain: An Online Log Parsing Approach with Fixed Depth Tree
Authors: P. He; J. Zhu; Z. Zheng; M. R. Lyu
Author Affiliations: Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong
Publication Title: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Web Services (ICWS)
Abstract: Logs record what a system does at runtime, and most log analysis starts by turning raw messages into templates. We present an online parser that walks a tree of fixed depth.

Document Title: Experience Report: System Log Analysis for Anomaly Detection
Authors: S. He; J. Zhu; P. He; M. R. Lyu
Author Affiliations: Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong
Publication Title: 2016 IEEE 27th International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE)
Abstract: Anomaly detection on system logs has been studied with many methods. This report reviews six of them and evaluates them on two public log datasets.

Document Title: An Evaluation Study on Log Parsing and Its Use in Log Mining
Authors: P. He; J. Zhu; S. He; J. Li; M. R. Lyu
Author Affiliations: Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong
Publication Title: 2016 46th Annual IEEE/IFIP International Conference on Dependable Systems and Networks (DSN)
Abstract: Log parsing turns free-text log messages into structured events. This study compares four parsers and measures how parsing errors change the results of later log mining.
